name: Clockify
description: Clockify is a time tracking and timesheet app that lets teams log work with a timer or manual entries, monitor activity, and generate reports on billable hours, project budgets, and team capacity.
best_for: Positioned for freelancers, agencies, developers, consultants, and construction companies that need to track productivity, attendance, and billable hours, with a free plan for unlimited users.
features: Timer, manual timesheet entry, and calendar view for logging time
Auto-tracker that turns app and website usage into time entries
Kiosk clock-in for shared-device attendance tracking
Detailed reports on activity, rates, earnings, and project budgets

alternatives.name: Toggl Track
alternatives.description: A time tracking tool with one-click timers, background activity tracking, and profitability reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting deeper profitability and workload reporting

alternatives.name: Hubstaff
alternatives.description: A workforce management and time tracking tool with automated timesheets, activity monitoring, and payroll integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing workforce proof-of-work tracking, scheduling, and automated payroll

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A project management platform for planning, tracking, and reporting on team work.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want project management alongside light time tracking via integrations
